# S Sridinesh - Comprehensive Developer Profile & Portfolio

This document provides a detailed breakdown of S Sridinesh's work, experience, and technical capabilities for deep LLM analysis.

## Professional Summary
S Sridinesh is a results-driven Full-Stack Developer based in Hyderabad, India. He specializes in the modern web stack (React, Next.js, TypeScript) and has a strong focus on AI integration. His projects often bridge the gap between complex AI capabilities (like Gemini and Computer Vision) and practical, user-friendly web interfaces.

## Project Case Studies

### 1. SparkCV (AI Resume Builder)
- **Problem:** Users struggle to create ATS-optimized resumes quickly.
- **Solution:** An AI-powered builder that provides real-time feedback and optimization.
- **Tech:** NextJS, React, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Stripe (for payments).
- **URL:** https://sparkcv.vercel.app/

### 2. CogniSketch (AI Drawing Analyzer)
- **Problem:** Translating hand-drawn sketches into digital data/equations is tedious.
- **Solution:** An AI calculator that uses Computer Vision (via Gemini API) to analyze sketches in real-time.
- **Tech:** React, Python, Gemini API, Tailwind CSS.
- **URL:** https://ai-smartsketch.onrender.com/

### 3. RecruitAI (Candidate Intelligence Platform)
- **Problem:** Biased and inefficient resume screening and lack of deterministic candidate scoring.
- **Solution:** A multi-agent candidate intelligence platform enforcing blind evaluations and structured ATS exports.
- **Tech:** Next.js, FastAPI, Python, LangGraph, Supabase.
- **URL:** https://recruitaiofficial.vercel.app/

### 4. FlowSync (AI Traffic Network Simulation)
- **Problem:** Urban traffic congestion and inefficient static traffic light timing.
- **Solution:** Real-time 3D simulation dynamically optimizing traffic signals using Dueling Double DQN (D3QN) and Prioritized Experience Replay.
- **Tech:** Next.js, React Three Fiber, PyTorch, FastAPI, Supabase.
- **URL:** https://flowsyncc.vercel.app/

### 5. MockingBird (Sarcasm Translator)
- **Tech:** React Native, Bun, Gemini API.
- **Innovation:** Creative use of LLMs for persona-based text transformation.
